verdict.rationale: MotherDuck Flights is a first-party feature for scheduled background automations: it runs "Python jobs on a schedule for ingest, transformation, and operational tasks" and handles the "Python runtime, scheduling, secrets, logging, and versioning." Flights are explicitly "built by your favorite agent and deployed in MotherDuck," which fits the AI-native persona. Saved Dives that "stay current with your data" add a lighter form of autonomous refresh. Evidence is limited to short product-page and getting-started claims. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on schedule/trigger configuration, failure handling and alerting, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Flights running unattended.
